generalComments.overallPerformance: Students generally performed well on AO1 knowledge questions but struggled with AO3 evaluation questions.
generalComments.advice: Students should practice extended writing and ensure they answer all parts of the question.

questionComments.comment: Most students could identify aerobic respiration and ATP, but many missed the chemical equation.
questionComments.exemplarPoints: Strong answers included the full chemical equation and explained the role of oxygen in the process.

questionComments.comment: Students performed adequately but often gave generic answers without specific details.
questionComments.exemplarPoints: Best answers linked warm-up activities to specific physiological responses.

questionComments.comment: Evaluation questions proved challenging. Students need to practice justifying their points.
commonMistakes: Describing training methods without evaluating them
questionComments.exemplarPoints: Top responses compared different training principles and evaluated their effectiveness with evidence.
